about: Every press probe 42 (audit/harness/probes/42-press-controls.mjs as of e2d8c578) wrote as 'nothing' on 1.2.118 (b5a29e73): each control of each window of probe 08's list pressed once on a fresh draw, and no window closed or opened, no text, field or control changed, no notice, file, focus move, server write or packet followed within 2.1 s. A candidate for a dead control, not a verdict. Two runs, both alone: 21.11.2026 00:05-00:33Z (the 47 windows the first run of 20.11 did not open) and 00:37-01:15Z (the first run's other windows). The `group` and `group_why` fields are the auditor's reading of the label and data attributes, not a reading of each handler in source: A = a blind spot the probe's header names, B = looks already selected, C = to read in source.
